title.en: Chapter 2 — The Servant and the Detective

sentences.ar: خادم فوغ اسمه باسبارتو، وكان رجل فرنسي طيّب.
sentences.en: Fogg's servant was named Passepartout, and he was a good-natured Frenchman.

sentences.ar: هو كان بس هلق بلّش يشتغل عند فوغ، وكان بدّه حياة هادية.
sentences.en: He had only just started working for Fogg, and he wanted a quiet life.

sentences.ar: بس هلق لقى حاله مسافر حول العالم!
sentences.en: But now he found himself traveling around the world!

sentences.ar: ركبوا القطار وبعدين المركب باتجاه مصر.
sentences.en: They took the train and then the ship toward Egypt.

sentences.ar: بنفس الوقت، بلندن، صار في سرقة كبيرة من البنك.
sentences.en: At the same time, in London, there was a big robbery at the bank.

sentences.ar: الشرطة كانت تدوّر على الحرامي، وشكّوا بفوغ.
sentences.en: The police were looking for the thief, and they suspected Fogg.

sentences.ar: مخبر اسمه فيكس راح يلحق فوغ ليمسكه.
sentences.en: A detective named Fix went to chase Fogg to catch him.

sentences.ar: فيكس صار يتبع فوغ من بلد لبلد.
sentences.en: Fix started following Fogg from country to country.

sentences.ar: بس ما كان معه ورقة تسمح له يمسكه بره إنجلترا.
sentences.en: But he didn't have a warrant that let him arrest him outside England.

sentences.ar: فقرر يمشي معهم ويستنى الفرصة المناسبة.
sentences.en: So he decided to travel with them and wait for the right chance.
